title: Census of India, 1901, Vol. I-A, India, Part II: Tables
publisher: Office of the Superintendent of Government Printing, India, 1903
locator: Table XV, p. 367 notes and Part III, pp. 396–397 and 400–401, Actual Workers. Table II-A, p. 10 supplies the resident totals, cross-referenced to Table I.
rights: Historical government publication. Numeric transcription and derived counts. Original scans linked.
notes: Selected printed order totals from the national volume's public OCR, supported by the visible corresponding sub-order counts. The national Central India Agency aggregate includes Gwalior. Rajputana Agency excludes the separate Ajmer-Merwara row. The Part III column for subsidiary agriculture and the Part II count of dependents are outside the admitted partition.
